text: Profile (cProfile, qew pr merge 7490 --check --ledger-only on the Foundlings ledger, 27,450 items / 214,298 events, 7.0.1): 11.1 s total; ledger snapshot (full) 9.25 s of it = read_files 3.4 s (81,799 stats 1.8 s, item cache 2.0 s, event cache 1.15 s), _events_of 2.1 s (parse_event_trusted 214k = 1.3 s), parse_item 27k = 1.35 s, fold 0.5 s, json loads 242k = 1.0 s, pathlib str/join overhead about 2 s; the PR index build is 1.4 s once. Per-PR cost after 6.57.1 is about 0.6 s. A lasting fix is a persisted parsed snapshot (or a partial snapshot of the covered items and their parent chains), not a micro-optimisation.
